material_class.structural_family: Ln6 octahedron supported by two p-tert-butylcalix[4]arene ligands

synthesis.procedure: General procedure for 1–4: LnCl3·6H2O (1 mmol) and TBC[4] (324 mg, 0.5 mmol) were dissolved in DMF (10 ml) and ROH (R = Me or Et, 10 ml). After 5 min of stirring, NEt3 (1.2 ml, 9 mmol) was added and the solution was stirred for a further 2 h. Colourless block-like crystals were obtained after filtration and diffusion of MeCN into the mother liquor. Compound 1 yield 87%.
synthesis.time: 5 min then 2 h after base addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: bench-top stirring; crystallization by MeCN diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration to remove undissolved material followed by diffusion of MeCN into the mother liquor to give colourless blocks

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility of powdered 1 (300–2 K, 0.1 T) shows χMT = 46.7 cm3 K mol−1 at high T (near the 47.25 cm3 K mol−1 spin-only Gd6 value), remaining nearly constant until ~75 K then falling to ~22.5 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, indicating very weak antiferromagnetic exchange. A 1J isotropic model gives J = −0.046 cm−1 with g = 2.00 and also reproduces M vs B data at 10, 4 and 2 K (B ≤ 7 T).

measurements.name: χMT (high T)
measurements.conditions: powdered crystals; 0.1 T; high-temperature limit of 300–2 K sweep

measurements.name: exchange coupling J
measurements.conditions: 1J isotropic Hamiltonian H = −2J Si·Sj; g fixed at 2.00

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the general procedure for 1–4: TbCl3·6H2O (1 mmol) and TBC[4] (324 mg, 0.5 mmol) in DMF (10 ml) and ROH (R = Me or Et, 10 ml); after 5 min stirring, NEt3 (1.2 ml, 9 mmol) was added and stirring continued for 2 h.
